description: A durable local supervisor for non-interactive coding-agent work, with a read-only client and plan-verified completion.
rules: Radioactive Ralph has one mutating supervisor and a dumb read-only client; do not describe personas or plugin variants.
Agent CLIs run non-interactively under Ralph-owned PTYs; durable plan state belongs in the user-level SQLite store, never in a repository runtime directory.
Plan completion is orchestrator-verified against acceptance criteria, not inferred from worker termination.
